items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I remember Sam Morgan very well.

ctx.x: I've been asked about some of the trumpet players. Do you remember Sam Morgan's band?

Sam Morgan, yes, Sam Morgan. I remember Sam Morgan very well. And I remember, just trumpet players? I remember Lee Collins. Oh, yeah. Oh, he was one of my favorites. I'd say in later years, right after I began playing, he was really one of my favorites. You know, of course, Lewis Armstrong on top all the time. I guess anybody else in those days felt the same. But Lee Collins was really one of my favorites. I'd say like in the years, beginning around 30. And even in 29, I was a short pass. No, no, it was before…
Is that the Astoria Hotel, that place?
